notes.title: Shine Bright: New Community Additions!
notes.content:
Hey there, folks! 🎉

We're thrilled to share some exciting news: we've just added some fantastic new achievements and items to our Steam community! 🌟

Now, your in-game accomplishments will shine even brighter with our cool achievements. And don't miss the chance to adorn your profile with favorite items that add a special charm to your virtual persona.

Join us, feel the magic and adventure, and enjoy these new opportunities with the Steam community! 💫

With love,
Lust Desires 🖤 team ✨

notes.title: Sex Magic 🔮 is finally out! And we've got something very special for you c
notes.content:
It's time to lose yourself in the world of intrigues, magic and hot characters - we worked tirelessly on the game, so your waiting will be worth it. Get to know (and not only to know - depends on what you decide to do 👀) Aurora, Violetta and others, alongside with your protagonist Adam, whose traveling journey brings him onto the steps of the city of Bloomgate - get ready to unleash all its small secrets in our graphically polished story-driven visual novel!

And as a small appreciation to the most attentive of you, gamers, we've got a gift - 10 free keys to the game. Take them and try them out - maybe you're just in time, and you'll get your own free copy!
